Upstream's install.md was not re-read today.

The bootstrap installs only the `ai-memory` executable from the verified archive (adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh:375-382). It deletes the staging extraction at exit (:298, :307-311); only the tarball stays in downloads (:291). The recipe's archive procedure extracts the whole archive and keeps its notices (recipes/README.md:58-59, :63), and the row says to retain native hooks and packaging files (:83). So packaging/systemd/ai-memory-user.service (:341) must be extracted from the cached tarball by hand. Whether 2.4.1 install-hooks needs any other bundled file is unverified; the card at :20 says release archives bundle hooks.

No Linux service unit is committed, and no exact command installs one. recipes/README.md:341 says to adapt upstream's packaging/systemd/ai-memory-user.service by hand; only `ai-memory serve ...` (:338) is recorded. The only committed unit template is the macOS one at adoption/launchd/com.native-stack.ai-memory.plist.template.

The port must be chosen and verified per host. AI_MEMORY_URL in adoption/hosts/example.json:8 defaults to 127.0.0.1:49374 (adoption/bootstrap.md:295-299). WSL distros share one network namespace: on this PC another distro holds 49374, and NativeStack binds 127.0.0.1:49474 (adoption/platforms/linux-wsl2.md:211-218). Point hooks, MCP and every CLI probe at the new distro's own server (recipes/README.md:350).

Codex hook trust is an interactive /hooks step, and nothing is captured until the hooks are trusted (recipes/README.md:399). manifests/stack.json:135 records the Codex PreCompact hook as still unverified after the upgrade.

--configure-full-profile refuses any checkout that is not at origin/main (adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh:197; adoption/bootstrap.md:242-253). On a release tag, steps 4 and 4a (config and hook rendering) are done by hand.

No Linux host besides nativestack-5975wx-20260925 has an ai-memory receipt. The Mac coordinator's self-reviewed use receipt at 2.4.0 (19b6429 build, unbound) is the only other host receipt. Neither transfers (adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json:121). The new distro needs its own install and use receipts. At 2.4.1 they can only be recorded with `scripts/host_receipts.py record --allow-unbound-version` (scripts/host_receipts.py:887-892), and they do not count toward the 2.3.2 winner's status. 'Accepted' also needs an independent review.

The pin is behind upstream: 2.4.1 versus v2.5.0 of 2026-09-30, as reported by the assessor. Migrations are forward-only (recipes/README.md:399), so a re-pin needs a release review and qualification. Whether 2.5.0 adds migrations was not verified.

Run the Collector curl/sha256/tar recipe at 0.161.0 with COLLECTOR_INSTALL_DIR=$STACK_TOOLS_ROOT/otelcol-contrib-0.161.0, and install Prometheus 3.14.0 from a scratch one-entry pins.json (observability/backends/README.md:112-116), because isostack.py:29-36 starts only those paths. Put the eight required commands on PATH. (3) Render the Collector unit, verify it and enable the six units. Acceptance: (a) 'adoption_status.py --profile observability' reports prerequisites_present. (b) reconcile_usage.py exits 0 with every verdict() check true (result_usage_equal_all_categories, before_empty, only_child_session_id, claude_exit_zero), and its --evaluate on a tampered copy of the result exits 1. (c) privacy_canary.py --mode privacy exits 0 with no missing positive control, and --mode passthrough exits 1. (d) On the installed services, check_persistence.py with a fresh --evidence-dir reports prometheus_historical_sample, loki_log, grafana_dashboard and grafana_datasources all true. (e) Before merging user exporter settings, run one fresh claude -p task whose OTLP env points only the child at the installed Collector (as reconcile_usage.py:92-111 does). Its four returned usage categories must equal the per-type Prometheus delta from an empty before-snapshot; once settings are merged, scope the query to the task's own instance series instead (observability/backends/README.md:170-173). Checks (b) and (c) test the repository config on isolated copies; only (d) and (e) test the installed pipeline. Retain versions, exit codes and every failure, including the path blocker if 3.14.0 is not installed.
